title: Practice: Losing, using up, cutting off

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: What does про- add in пропи́ть (“to spend/squander on drink”)?
options: an action spreading over the whole object
completeness, exhaustion or thoroughness of an action
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists пропи́ть under this meaning of про-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «про-», meaning 7 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/про-).

exercises.q: What does про- add in проигра́ть (“to lose”)?
options: an action lasting for a certain stretch of time
an action spreading over the whole object
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists проигра́ть under this meaning of про-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «про-», meaning 7 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/про-).

exercises.q: What does про- add in пропасть (“precipice, abyss, chasm”)?
options: describing an action that entails completeness, exhaustiveness, or accuracy
(used with adjectives or nouns) describing an initial appearance or insufficiency of characteristics
describing an action that describes losses, expenses, wasting, or forgetting
exercises.why: Wiktionary lists пропасть under this meaning of про-. Source: Wiktionary, «про-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/про-#Russian).

exercises.q: What does у- add in уничто́жить (“to destroy, to annihilate, to obliterate, to wipe out, to blot out, to crush”)?
options: completing the action of the base verb, bringing it to a result or to exhaustive fullness
destroying or using up the object by the action of the base verb
making the object as many times bigger as the base numeral says
keeping in the state the base verb names
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists уничто́жить under this meaning of у-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «у-», meaning 11 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/у-).

exercises.q: What does из- add in исписа́ть (“to cover with writing”)?
options: destroying, reducing to nothing by use
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists исписа́ть under this meaning of из-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «из-», meaning 3 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/из-).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to destroy, to annihilate, to obliterate, to wipe out, to blot out, to crush
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: пропи́ть — to spend/squander on drink; проигра́ть — to lose; пропасть — precipice, abyss, chasm; уничто́жить — to destroy, to annihilate, to obliterate, to wipe out, to blot out, to crush.
**исписан** — исписа́ть (perfective): to cover with writing; (pen, pencil) to use up. Wiktionary: ис- + писа́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **исписал** — исписа́ть (perfective): to cover with writing; (pen, pencil) to use up. Wiktionary: ис- + писа́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: What does с- add in сре́зать (“to cut off, to shear off, to slice off”)?
options: shared participation in something, or shared belonging
movement from different sides to one point
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists сре́зать under this meaning of с-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «с-», meaning 3 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/с-).

exercises.q: What does с- add in скоси́ть (“to mow (down)”)?
options: shared participation in something, or shared belonging
the limit, the result of the action itself
place or manner of an action
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists скоси́ть under this meaning of с-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «с-», meaning 3 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/с-).

exercises.q: What does пере- add in перере́зать (“(all or many) to kill, to slaughter”)?
options: describing a destructed state of an entity, usually by cutting or tearing with tools or tool-like implements
describing a consequence of a completed action that affects many entities of a group
exercises.why: Wiktionary lists перере́зать under this meaning of пере-. Source: Wiktionary, «пере-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/пере-#Russian).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to cut off, to shear off, to slice off
(all or many) to kill, to slaughter
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: исписа́ть — to cover with writing; сре́зать — to cut off, to shear off, to slice off; скоси́ть — to mow (down); перере́зать — (all or many) to kill, to slaughter.
